name: Booking
looksLike: a website where I choose a time and reserve it
a page for booking a service on a date
definition: A website that lets visitors choose a service, date, or time, review availability and terms, and make a reservation with a clear confirmation.
goal: Help visitors reserve an available service or time slot.
audience: People arranging an appointment or reservation

sections.name: Choose a service
sections.purpose: Explain the options, duration, and price.

sections.name: Choose availability
sections.purpose: Show usable dates, times, and time zones.

sections.name: Review and reserve
sections.purpose: Collect necessary details and show terms before submission.

sections.name: Confirmation and changes
sections.purpose: Provide a reference and a way to change or cancel.

prompts.short: Build a booking site with service selection, available times, clear terms, and reservation confirmation.
prompts.detailed: Build a booking website for people arranging an appointment or reservation. Help visitors reserve an available service or time slot. Include choose a service, choose availability, review and reserve, confirmation and changes. Use responsive layouts, clear labels, keyboard access, and visible focus. Explicit time zone and availability.
